email.subject: Blue Pipe Co: quick fix for lost booking calls
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Blue Pipe Co's website. Two things are likely costing you jobs:

There's no way to book or request service directly on the site, so visitors who find you after hours just leave and call the next plumber in Harbor Falls.

Also, your homepage title doesn't mention plumbing or Harbor Falls, which hurts how you show up in local searches when someone needs a plumber nearby.

Both are quick to fix. I run a one-person shop that fixes this for a flat fee, no contracts.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change? No pitch, just the screen.

Alex
